children.game_version: Play the 'Bumblebee Garden' game where one child flutters scarf wings while another plays the fan-bearing pursuer.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the upper-body 'oleg' torso swaying and arm scarf movements while seated securely on a chair.
seniors.standing_version: Practice head tilts, eye shifts, and gentle fan flutter movements while standing near a supportive barre.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce rapid head turns and limit arm extension height to comfortably below shoulder level at a moderate pace.

learning_units.description: Execute the upper torso sway ('oleg') with high arm wing posture.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Female dancer extends arms with sheer scarf for wings; male dancer manipulates a hand fan
movement_profile.footwork: Agile, intricate Balinese steps; detailed counts not described in sources
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Duet dynamic; male dancer pursues female dancer across an open performance floor
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Fluid torso oscillations ('oleg' in Balinese means swaying movement)
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low to medium grounded Balinese stances; jumps not described in sources
movement_profile.partnering: Flirtatious duet interaction where male approaches and female responds
movement_profile.posture: Swaying, oscillating Balinese posture with raised arms holding wing-like scarf

signature_moves.description: Female dancer raises arms high to expand a sheer scarf, creating a buzzing flight illusion.
signature_moves.name: Wing Flight Scarf Motion

signature_moves.description: Male dancer pursues the female across the floor using rhythmic fan movements.
signature_moves.name: Fan Pursuit

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Vivacious, playful, and swift with sudden dramatic pauses
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid stiff upper body posture or static arm positions, as continuous swaying ('oleg') and fluid wing motion are vital.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Dynamic gamelan kebyar rhythms with dramatic tempo changes
music_profile.sound_description: Shimmering, explosive gamelan kebyar music featuring swift rhythmic turns and layered metallic resonance that mimics the buzzing energy of garden wildlife.
